limits: A 1-frame 0 press at zero-based frame 530 did not restart; a 5-frame press did, and 5/10/20-frame holds yielded identical 800 RAM hashes in this state. The life byte briefly changes during reinitialization; only frame 660 onward is described as stable. Holding W at frames 680..719 changed RAM but not actor X/Y/kind by frame 800, even with a tested keyboard menu-option press; no early-start movement rule is established. This is one bounded restart after the selected no-fire path, not a complete menu/options or fresh-tape initialization specification. Source pixels and per-frame replay hashes stay private.
